rationale: Public CUDA DFT forces use one method-name-free and architecture-agnostic active-AO policy keyed by execution composition, spin, derivative order, provider/resource identity and a continuous dense-work cost proxy. Ordinary all-electron Direct RKS/UKS force execution with supported AO-jet orders 1/2 admits map discovery once predicted dense point×AO² work reaches the retained positive crossover; every capability/resource/profitability miss remains dense. CUDA architecture is recorded as workload provenance only and is not a selection predicate. Native stationary controllers restore the same derivative-specific cutoff through bounded exact sampled-jet bitmasks at the 2**35 work crossover, retaining dense execution on resource or occupancy misses.
revisit_condition: Refine the cost crossover with additional devices and workload shapes rather than adding architecture, molecule, atom-count, AO-count or grid-count windows. Ordinary DF already uses the independently qualified native AO-jet bitmask producer at its own 2**35 dense-work crossover. Broaden to composite execution or ECP only with source/device-identified complete endpoint evidence; keep every unsupported or unprofitable case dense.
